people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
translations.bsb: Abraham replied, “Make sure that you do not take my son back there.
translations.kjv: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
translations.asv: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
